title: lilium pomponium var. carniolicum
intro: Lilium pomponium var. carniolicum, commonly known as Carniolan lily, is a variety of the Lilium pomponium plant, which is a species of lily native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Carniolan lily include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can help to alleviate coughs, colds, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
